Q1.rationale: Base [2] and [3] require the Disclosee to keep all Confidential Information confidential and bar disclosure to any other person, including regulators, and the only regulatory carve-out ([22]) covers legally compelled disclosure with prior notice, not voluntary reports of possible violations; V1 changes only the governing-law clause.
Q1.label: Entailment
